blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型最近配备了触觉感知器,以在丰富的接触操纵中感知视觉微妙的接触事件。 然而,添加触觉输入会产生不一致的增益,一些粘着作用的VLA模型很少依赖触觉输入,因为许多触觉变化,如抓刀关闭时的凝胶变形,从视觉观察和被执行的动作中是可预测的. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了TacInno,它隔离了视觉和执行行动无法解释的联系动态,称为触觉创新,并将触觉创新仅仅用作培训目标。 具体来说,以视觉观察和执行动作为条件的TacInno示意器将未来的触觉变化压缩为离散代码,政策TacInno-VLA学习预测代码,在部署时没有为代码添加模块. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robotic manipulation [ 5 , 19 , 4 , 27 ] . Building on pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), VLA models learn to predict robot actions from visual observations, language instructions, and proprioceptive states through imitation learning [ 3 ] . Nevertheless, contact-rich manipulation remains challenging, as critical contact events, such as incipient slip and jamming during insertion, are often difficult to infer from external visual observations. To capture contact events, recent efforts augment VLA models with tactile observations [ 40 , 16 , 38 , 44 , 26 , 42 , 11 , 2 , 22 ] , typically acquired by vision-based tactile sensors such as GelSight [ 41 ] and DIGIT [ 20 ] , which capture the deformation of a soft gel.
blocks.zh: 愿景-语言-行动模型已成为处理通用机器人操纵的一种有希望的方法[5、19、4、27]。 VLA模型在预先训练的Visual-Langage Models(VLMs)的基础上,通过模仿学习来从视觉观测,语言指令,以及自发状态中去预测机器人动作[3]. 尽管如此,大量接触操纵仍然具有挑战性,因为关键的接触事件,如入场滑倒和插入过程中的干扰,往往难以从外部视觉观察中推断出. 为了捕捉到接触事件,最近的努力用触觉观测增强VLA模型[40, 16, 38, 44, 26, 42, 11, 2, 22], 通常是由基于视觉的触觉传感器如GelSight[41]和DIGIT[20]获得的,它们捕捉出软凝胶的变形.

blocks.en: Existing visuo-tactile policies incorporate tactile observations as additional inputs [ 16 , 32 , 40 , 43 , 49 ] , predict future tactile signals [ 9 , 13 , 33 , 38 , 46 ] , or emphasize tactile changes during training [ 10 , 25 , 36 , 37 , 45 ] ( Fig. 1 c). However, incorporating tactile inputs yields inconsistent gains and can even reduce the success rate relative to the same VLA without tactile inputs [ 40 , 44 ] . Moreover, we apply a tactile-off test, which removes tactile input at test time, and find that the success rates of some existing policies change little, indicating limited reliance on tactile information ( Sec. 4.4 ). We attribute the inconsistent gains and the limited reliance to the nature of the tactile signal, since a tactile sensor measures how the contact responds to the robot’s own actions. Consequently, given the initial tactile observation, a substantial portion of the subsequent tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions ( Sec. 4.5 , Fig. 1 a). As an input, the predictable portion is largely redundant, and adding an input modality can even degrade performance [ 34 ] . When future tactile signals are the prediction target, the predictable portion makes up most of the target, so the prediction loss is dominated by changes that vision and executed actions already explain. Weighting the loss by the magnitude of tactile change does not help, since the largest changes are often the predictable ones ( Fig. 4 ). A central question arises: How can the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain be isolated and used to guide VLA policy learning?
blocks.zh: 现有的触觉观察政策将触觉观察作为补充投入[16、32、40、43、49],预测未来的触觉信号[9、13、33、38、46],或强调训练过程中的触觉变化[10、25、36、37、45](图1c)。 然而,纳入触觉输入会产生不一致的收益,甚至可以相对同一VLA降低成功率,而无需触觉输入[40,44]. 此外,我们采用触觉关闭测试,在测试时去掉触觉输入,发现一些现有政策的成功率变化不大,表明对触觉信息的依赖有限(第4.4节)。 我们把不一致的收益和有限的依赖归因于触觉信号的性质,因为触觉传感器衡量接触如何应对机器人自己的行为。 因此,鉴于最初的触觉观察,从视觉观察和已执行的行动来看,随后发生的触觉变化,如抓取器关闭时的凝胶变形,有很大一部分是可以预测的(Sec. 4.5, 图1a)。 作为投入,可预见部分基本上是多余的,而添加输入模式甚至可以降低性能[34]. 当未来的触觉信号是预测目标时,可预见部分占了目标的大部分,因此预测损失主要是视觉和执行动作已经解释的变化. 按触觉变化的程度来权衡损失是无益的,因为最大的变化往往是可预测的变化(图4)。 一个核心问题是: 设想和执行行动的联系动态如何不能被孤立地用来指导志愿军的政策学习?

blocks.en: To answer this question, we propose TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain as the supervision signal for VLA training. Inspired by the notion of innovation in estimation theory [ 18 , 17 ] , we define tactile innovation as the residual tactile change after accounting for the initial tactile observation, visual observations, and executed actions. Three properties of tactile innovation determine the design of TacInno. First, tactile innovation is conditional on visual observations and executed actions. We therefore introduce the TacInno tokenizer, which learns a compact discrete code as a proxy for tactile innovation and conditions both its encoder and decoder on the corresponding visual observations and executed actions, so that the code retains the contact dynamics that the two conditions cannot explain ( Fig. 1 b). Second, tactile innovation is dynamic , arising from transient contact events, such as incipient slip, that span several control steps. The tokenizer therefore encodes a short sequence of tactile observations with causal temporal attention rather than a single pair of frames. Third, tactile innovation lies in the future and is unavailable when the policy acts. We therefore train TacInno-VLA to predict the code from current observations as an auxiliary objective, supervising the tactile representations used for action prediction. The code serves only as a training target, and the tokenizer and auxiliary prediction heads are removed at deployment.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们提议使用TacInno,它将设想和执行的行动的接触动态隔离开来,不能解释为对志愿军培训的监督信号。 在估算理论的创新概念[18,17]的启发下,我们把触觉创新定义为在计算出初始触觉观测,视觉观测,以及执行行动之后的残余触觉变化. 触觉创新的三个属性决定了TacInno的设计. 第一,触觉创新以视觉观察和执行行动为条件。 因此,我们引入了TacInno符号化器,它学习了紧凑的离散代码,作为触觉创新的代名词,并在相应的视觉观测和已执行的动作上同时设置了编码器和解码器,从而使代码保留了两个条件无法解释的联系动态(图1b). 第二,触觉创新是动态的,产生于跨越若干控制步骤的即时接触事件,如初发滑行等。 因此,指示器编码了短暂的触觉观察序列,带有因果时间关注而不是一对帧. 第三,触觉创新在于未来,当政策实施时是不存在的。 因此,我们训练TacInno-VLA从目前的观测中预测代码,作为辅助目标,监督用于动作预测的触觉表示. 代码仅作为训练目标,部署时会去掉标致器和辅助预测头.

blocks.en: We evaluate TacInno on six contact-rich tasks from the UniVTAC benchmark [ 8 ] and four real-world tasks using a Franka FR3 robot equipped with a vision-based tactile sensor. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% in simulation and 70.5% in the real world, the highest among the evaluated visuo-tactile policies. Ablation studies verify the contribution of each design, and the tactile-off test confirms that TacInno-VLA relies on tactile input.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • With the tactile-off test, we show that some existing visuo-tactile policies rely little on tactile input, attribute the limited reliance to the redundancy of the tactile signal, and propose to separate the tactile change that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation. • We propose TacInno, which encodes tactile innovation into a discrete code with a conditional multi-frame tokenizer and uses the code solely as an auxiliary training target, adding no module for the code at deployment. • TacInno-VLA outperforms the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points in average success rate in simulation and the real world, respectively. The success rate of TacInno-VLA drops from 88% to 0% on Lift Can under the tactile-off test and by 21 percentage points on the lifting tasks when the code encodes the entire tactile change.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Earlier visuo-tactile policies fuse tactile images [ 21 , 15 , 23 ] or pretrained tactile representations [ 14 , 47 ] with visual features in imitation-learning policies such as ACT [ 48 ] and Diffusion Policy [ 12 ] . Recent methods extend tactile sensing to VLA models in three progressive directions ( Fig. 1 c). The first incorporates tactile observations as additional inputs and relies on the action loss alone to determine how the tactile inputs are used [ 40 , 16 , 43 , 32 , 49 , 26 , 42 , 11 , 2 , 22 ] . Because the action loss rewards only what improves the imitated actions, the policy is not required to use the tactile inputs, and the gains are modest and occasionally negative [ 40 , 44 ] . FACT [ 29 ] further replaces the tactile input with noise to examine how much of the reported gain originates from tactile information. The second direction therefore assigns the tactile signal an objective of its own and predicts future tactile signals, either within the policy [ 38 , 9 , 13 , 24 ] or through tactile world models [ 33 , 46 ] . Since predicting every future tactile signal spends much of the supervision on periods in which the contact hardly changes, the third direction emphasizes tactile changes during training by weighting or gating the tactile signal according to the magnitude of its change [ 10 , 45 , 25 , 36 , 37 ] . However, the second and third directions still supervise the tactile representation with the entire future tactile change, including the component that vision and executed actions already explain. Our method extends this progression by supervising only the component that vision and executed actions cannot explain. The closest work, ResTacVLA [ 44 ] , uses the quantized residual between visually predicted and observed tactile representations as a policy input, whereas our code encodes the future tactile change that vision and executed actions cannot explain and serves only as a training target.
blocks.zh: 早期的活性政策能使触觉图像[21、15、23]或预训练有素的触觉表现[14、47],具有模仿学习政策中的视觉特征,如ACT[48]和扩散政策[12]。 最近的方法将触觉感知扩展到了三个进步方向的VLA模型(图1c. 第一种是将触觉观察作为补充投入纳入,仅依靠动作损失来确定触觉输入是如何使用的[40、16、43、32、49、26、42、11、2、22]。 由于动作损失只奖励改进所模仿的动作,所以政策不需要使用触觉输入,收益是适度的,偶尔是负的[40,44]. FACT[29]进一步将触觉输入用噪音来取而代之,以检查所报告的收益中有多少来自触觉信息. 因此,第二个方向将触觉信号指定为自己的目标,并预测未来的触觉信号,要么在政策范围内[38,9,13,24],要么通过触觉世界模型[33,46]. 由于预测出每个未来的触觉信号将大部分监管时间花在接触几乎没有变化的时期上,第三个方向强调在训练中会通过根据触觉信号变化的大小进行加权或取入触觉信号来进行触觉变化[10,45,25,36,37]. 然而,第二和第三个方向仍然监督触觉表现与整个未来触觉变化,包括设想和执行行动已经解释的部分。 我们的方法延长了这一进展,只监督设想和执行的行动无法解释的部分。 最近的作品ResTacVLA [44] 将视觉预测和所观察到的触觉表现之间的量化后残留作为政策投入,而我们的代码编码了未来触觉变化,即视觉和执行的行动不能解释,只能作为一个培训目标。

blocks.en: Vector-quantized variational autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) [ 31 ] learn compact discrete representations by mapping continuous features to entries in a learned codebook and reconstructing observations from the quantized codes. Vector quantization has been extended to temporal modeling, where discrete latent variables capture transitions between observations. Genie [ 6 ] learns latent actions from unlabeled videos to enable controllable video generation. LAPA [ 39 ] employs a VQ-VAE-based action tokenizer to extract discrete latent actions from video transitions, which serve as supervision for VLA pretraining. UniVLA [ 7 ] further incorporates language conditioning into inverse- and forward-dynamics learning to obtain task-centric latent actions. Building on discrete latent dynamics learning, our method applies vector quantization to tactile observations. The encoder compresses a sequence of tactile observations into discrete codes, while the decoder reconstructs future tactile changes conditioned on the current tactile state, visual observations, and executed actions. Unlike latent action models, which infer unobserved actions, our tokenizer is trained on demonstrations with known actions and therefore provides the actions to both the encoder and the decoder. With conditional reconstruction, the codes retain only the contact dynamics that the conditioning information cannot explain.

blocks.en: In this section, we present TacInno in three parts ( Figs. 2 and 3 ). First, Sec. 3.1 formulates the problem and defines tactile innovation. Then, Sec. 3.2 presents the TacInno tokenizer, which isolates tactile innovation from demonstrations and labels each demonstration frame with a discrete code. Finally, Sec. 3.3 describes TacInno-VLA, which is trained to predict the code as an auxiliary objective.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: At control step t t , the policy receives visual observations o t o_{t} , a language instruction ℓ \ell , the proprioceptive state q t q_{t} , and the tactile observation X t X_{t} , which comprises the indentation depth map and the marker displacement field of the vision-based tactile sensors. blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We describe the experimental setup in Sec. 4.1 , compare TacInno-VLA with visuo-tactile baselines in simulation in Sec. 4.2 , and ablate each design in Sec. 4.3 . Section 4.4 examines whether each policy relies on tactile input, Sec. 4.5 verifies that a substantial portion of the tactile change is predictable from vision and executed actions, and Sec. 4.6 evaluates TacInno-VLA in the real world.
blocks.zh: 我们在第4.1节中描述了实验设置,在模拟第4.2节中将TacInno-VLA与粘土活性基线进行比较,并在第4.2节中放弃每一项设计。 4.3 (英语). 第4.4节审查每项政策是否都依赖触觉输入,第4.5节核实,从愿景和执行的行动来看,触觉变化的很大一部分是可以预测的,第4.6节评价了现实世界的TacInno-VLA。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We adopt six tasks from the UniVTAC benchmark [ 8 ] , namely Insert Hole, Insert Tube, Lift Bottle, Lift Can, Pull-out Key, and Put Bottle in Shelf (Put Bottle), simulated in Isaac Sim with two vision-based tactile sensors [ 41 ] rendered by Taxim [ 30 ] . Each task provides 100 expert demonstrations, of which demonstrations 0 to 49 are used to train the policies, 0 to 89 to train the tokenizer, and 90 to 99 are held out for analysis. We further set up four real-world tasks, namely wiping a board, inserting a plug into a power strip, lifting a lying can upright, and unscrewing a bottle cap, with a Xense vision-based tactile sensor on the fingertip of a Franka FR3 gripper ( Sec. 4.6 ). For each real-world task, we collect 50 demonstrations by teleoperation with GELLO [ 35 ] at 30 Hz, of which the first 45 train the policies and the tokenizer. Each policy is evaluated for 100 episodes per task with identical random seeds in simulation ( Tabs. 1 and 2 ) and for 50 trials per task in the real world.
blocks.zh: 我们从UniVTAC基准[8]中通过了六项任务,即:插入洞、插入管、起起瓶、起罐、拉出键和将瓶装入大陆架(Put Bottle),在Isaac Sim模拟使用由出租车公司制造的两个以视觉为基础的触觉传感器[41]。 每项任务提供100个专家演示,其中0至49个演示用于训练政策,0至89个演示用于训练活化剂,90至99个演示用于进行分析. 我们进一步设置了四个现实世界的任务,即:将一个板子擦去,将一个插头插入到一个电源条中,把一个躺倒的罐子抬起直立起来,并解开一个瓶盖,用一个以Xense视觉为主的触觉传感器在Franka FR3抓取器的指尖上(第4.6节). 为了完成现实世界的每一项任务,我们收集了50个与GELLO[35]在30Hz进行远程合作的演示,其中前45个训练了政策和说明器。 每项政策在模拟(Tab. 1和2)中每作100次随机种子相同的任务,并在现实世界中每作50次试验,都得到评价。

blocks.en: We compare TacInno-VLA against five visuo-tactile baselines, namely UniVTAC-ACT, the visuo-tactile ACT provided by the benchmark [ 8 , 48 ] , FTP- π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and FTP-1 (Foundation Tactile Policy) [ 40 ] , 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA [ 26 ] , and SimpleTouch [ 38 ] . We also report π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 3 ] , the VLA on which TacInno-VLA is built, fine-tuned as a multi-task policy without tactile input. For fair comparison, all baselines are retrained on the same demonstrations with the official configurations, including the action execution horizon, and evaluated under the same protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们比较TacInno-VLA与五个活性基准,即UniVTAC-ACT、基准[8、48]、FTP- ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}和FTP-1(Foundation Tactile Policy)[40]、N 0\mathcal{N}_{0}-VTLA[26]和SimpleTouch[38]提供的活性ACT。 我们还报告 \ 0.5\ pi\ 0.5} [3],TacInno-VLA 所基于的VLA, 微调为多任务政策,没有触觉输入. 为了进行公平比较,所有基线都根据官方配置,包括行动执行范围,在相同的演示上重新培训,并根据同一协议进行评估。

blocks.en: 4.2 Simulation Experiment
blocks.zh: 4.2 模拟实验

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 1 , TacInno-VLA achieves an average success rate of 87.5% across the six tasks, 10.7 and 12.2 percentage points above the two strongest baselines, SimpleTouch and 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA. Moreover, TacInno-VLA is the only policy that reaches at least 75% on every task, whereas each baseline drops to 54% or below on at least one task. With the execution horizon of TacInno-VLA, the baselines average 82.0% (FTP-1), 79.3% (SimpleTouch), 78.0% ( 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA), and 68.0% (FTP- π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ), all below the 91.3% of TacInno-VLA on the same seeds. Note that TacInno-VLA requires no tactile pretraining, whereas FTP-1 and 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA are initialized from policies pretrained on external visuo-tactile data, and SimpleTouch employs a frozen encoder pretrained on external tactile data.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Section 1 attributes the limited benefit of tactile input to the redundancy of the tactile signal and derives three designs from the attribution. To verify each design, Tab. 2 removes or alters one design of TacInno-VLA at a time on the two lifting tasks, on which the tactile-off test distinguishes TacInno-VLA from the baselines ( Sec. 4.4 ). The variant without tactile input is the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} of Tab. 1 , and every other variant follows the training recipe, data, random seeds, and action execution horizon of TacInno-VLA. All differences refer to the success rate averaged over the two tasks.
blocks.zh: 第1节将触觉输入的有限好处归因于触觉信号的冗余,并从归属中衍生出三种设计. 为了验证每个设计,Tab. 2在两个起重任务上一次去除或修改了TacInno-VLA的一个设计,在这两个起重任务上,触觉关闭试验将TacInno-VLA与基线区分开来(sec.4.4)。 没有触觉输入的变体是Tab. 1的 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5},其他的变体都遵循了TacInno-VLA的训练食谱,数据,随机种子和动作执行地平线. 所有差异均指两个任务的平均成功率.

blocks.en: To verify the necessity of conditioning, we remove the visual observations and executed actions from both the encoder and the decoder of the tokenizer, so that the code encodes the entire future tactile change (w/o conditioning), which lowers the average success rate by 21 points. Conditioning the tokenizer on the visual observations alone, as in a visual residual [ 44 ] (vision-only conditioning), recovers only part of the drop, and the average success rate remains 13.5 points lower. On held-out Lift Can demonstrations, the fraction of the tactile change that the decoder explains only through the code is 48% without conditioning, 40% with the visual observations alone, 23% with the executed actions alone, and 13% with both conditions. The action-induced change is therefore removed by the executed actions rather than by the visual observations, and continues to dominate a code conditioned on vision alone.
blocks.zh: 为了验证调制是否必要,我们从标定器的编码器和解码器中去除可视化观察并执行动作,使代码编码了整个未来的触觉变化(w/oculation),使平均成功率降低了21分. 仅以视觉观察为条件的标注器,如在视觉残余 [44] (仅以视觉为条件)中,只恢复了部分下降,平均成功率仍然较低出13.5分. 在被搁置的"升起"(Left Can)演示中,解码器仅通过代码解释的触觉变化的一小部分是48%不设条件,40%只用视觉观察,23%只用已执行的行动,13%用两种条件. 因此,行动引起的变化被执行的行动所去除,而不是被视觉观察所去除,并继续主宰着仅以视觉为条件的代码.

blocks.en: To examine whether the code must describe a sequence of tactile observations, we compute the code from only the two endpoints of the window, t t and t + 15 t{+}15 (two-frame code), while keeping the policy unchanged. The average success rate drops by 6.5 points, since a code computed from the two endpoints misses the contact events that occur within the window.

blocks.en: To examine whether the code must serve as a training target rather than an input, we allow the action tokens to attend to the code queries (w/o attention mask). The average success rate drops by 15 points, demonstrating that the code is most effective when action prediction cannot access the code queries.

blocks.en: Removing the tactile branch (w/o tactile input) and the code prediction loss (w/o code loss) reduces the average success rate by 57.5 and 7 points, respectively. The tactile branch provides the tactile signal, whereas the code prediction loss determines which part of the tactile signal the policy retains.

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis of Tactile Reliance
blocks.zh: 4.4 试管依赖性分析

blocks.en: A higher success rate does not by itself indicate that a policy relies on tactile input. We therefore apply the tactile-off test, which replaces the tactile input with a fixed no-contact frame at test time and keeps all other inputs unchanged, so that any change in the success rate is attributable solely to tactile input. Table 3 reports the results on the two lifting tasks, in which the object must be grasped firmly enough to be lifted yet loosely enough to rotate in the grasp. Removing tactile input reduces the success rate of TacInno-VLA from 88% to 0% on Lift Can and to 4% on Lift Bottle, whereas 𝒩 0 \mathcal{N}_{0} -VTLA, FTP-1, and SimpleTouch retain most of their success rates, and FTP-1 even improves on Lift Bottle. Without tactile input, TacInno-VLA reaches the can but fails to lift the can, whereas FTP-1 still completes the task. The open-loop results on Lift Can are consistent with the closed-loop results. On held-out demonstrations, the same replacement increases the errors of the arm and gripper actions predicted by TacInno-VLA by 156% and 238%, respectively, far more than for any baseline. On tasks whose outcome depends on the grasp, the actions of TacInno-VLA therefore depend on tactile input.

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis of Tactile Innovation
blocks.zh: 4.5 技术创新分析

blocks.en: To verify the decomposition in Eq. 2 at the dataset level, we train probes on the six tasks to predict the code without conditioning and the tactile innovation code, each from the context alone (task, visual observations, proprioceptive state, and executed future actions) or from the context together with the tactile history, and measure in nats, on the held-out demonstrations, the information that the tactile history adds beyond the context. For the code without conditioning, which encodes the entire future tactile change, the tactile history adds only 0.020 nats, so the context alone already accounts for 97% of the information extracted with the tactile history. For the tactile innovation code, the tactile history adds 0.073 nats, 3.6 × \times as much. The entire future tactile change, which tactile world models use as the prediction target, is therefore largely predictable without tactile input.
blocks.zh: 为了在数据集层面验证Eq. 2中的分解,我们训练了探测器,研究了六项任务,以不设条件地预测代码和触觉创新代码,每个任务都分别来自上下文(任务,视觉观察,自发状态,以及执行后的行动)或上下文与触觉历史,并用纳特语测量被搁置的演示,触觉历史在上下文之外增加的信息. 对于没有条件的代码,它编码了整个未来的触觉变化,触觉历史只增加了0.020纳特,因此仅上下文就已经占了从触觉历史中提取的信息的97%. 对于触觉创新代码,触觉历史增加了0.073纳特,3.6×\时等. 因此,整个未来的触觉变化,即触觉世界模型用作预测目标,在不触觉输入的情况下,基本上是可预测的.

blocks.en: Measured with the tokenizer on held-out demonstrations, the fraction of the tactile change that visual observations and executed actions cannot explain averages 37% over the six tasks. The probe performs comparably on the tactile tokens of the two policies at the input layer of the action expert, but within the action expert the two policies differ on the 10% of windows with the largest tactile innovation, where the tactile tokens of TacInno-VLA predict the code with a top-1 accuracy of 49.0%, compared with 38.6% for the variant without the code prediction loss. Tactile input also modulates the attention of TacInno-VLA. After accounting for the magnitude of the tactile change, the attention from the action tokens to the tactile tokens correlates with tactile innovation, and replacing the tactile input with a no-contact frame removes 90% of the correlation, compared with 13% for the variant without the code prediction loss. The code prediction loss therefore alters the tactile information that the action expert retains.

blocks.en: We evaluate TacInno-VLA on four contact-rich real-world tasks against two visuo-tactile baselines, FTP-1 and SimpleTouch, and three ablated settings of TacInno-VLA, namely without tactile input, without the code prediction loss, and under the tactile-off test. All policies are trained on the same demonstrations. From the depth and marker estimates of the sensor, we compute the same indentation depth map and marker displacement field as in simulation. A trial is counted as successful when the writing is wiped off the board, the plug is fully inserted, the can stands upright, or the cap is separated from the bottle, with the same criteria for all policies. As shown in Tab. 4 , TacInno-VLA achieves an average success rate of 70.5%, surpassing SimpleTouch and FTP-1 by 9.0 and 12.0 percentage points, respectively, as well as all three ablated settings. The code prediction loss improves every real-world task by 16 to 26 percentage points. The comparable success rates of the variants without the code prediction loss (47.5%) and without tactile input (51.5%) indicate that, on the real-world tasks, the tactile branch is beneficial only when trained with tactile innovation as the target.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we address the redundancy of the tactile signal in visuo-tactile VLA models, where a substantial portion of the tactile change is predictable from vision and executed actions. To this end, we introduce TacInno, which isolates tactile innovation and uses tactile innovation solely as a training target. Central to TacInno is a conditional multi-frame tokenizer that encodes tactile innovation into a 16-bit discrete code, which TacInno-VLA predicts as an auxiliary objective. Experiments on six simulation tasks and four real-world tasks show that TacInno-VLA achieves the highest average success rates among the evaluated visuo-tactile policies and relies on tactile input, and that removing the conditioning from the tokenizer lowers the success rate by 21 percentage points. The notion of innovation is not specific to tactile sensing, and extending TacInno to other modalities is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们处理VLA模型中触觉信号的冗余问题,在VLA模型中,很大一部分触觉变化是从视觉和执行行动中可以预测的。 为此,我们引入了TacInno,它孤立了触觉创新,并将触觉创新仅仅作为培训目标. 塔克因诺中心是有条件的多帧活化剂,将触觉创新编码为16位离散码,塔克因诺-VLA预测为辅助目标. 对6个模拟任务和4个现实世界任务进行的实验表明,TacInno-VLA在被评价的相对活性政策中实现了最高的平均成功率并依赖于触觉输入,从活性剂中去除条件使成功率降低了21个百分点. 创新概念并不特指触觉感知,将TacInno扩展至其他方式留待未来工作.
